items.sentence: It is well known that attention is often attracted to phenomena that are familiar to the observer but that turn up in an unusual environment, or to new phenomena in a familiar environment.

items.sentence: We owe it to ourselves and to the next generation to conserve the environment so that we can bequeath our children a sustainable world that benefits all.

items.sentence: We owe it to ourselves and to the next generation to conserve the environment so that we can bequeath our children a sustainable world that benefits all.
items.prompt: ‘to prevent natural resources from being damaged or destroyed’에 해당하는 문장 속 단어를 입력하세요.
